The work was substantial and generally purposeful, with no add-delete-rebuild cycle and no repeated NO-OP thrash. The main economy blemish is wall time: 936.2 seconds, or 15.6 minutes, slightly exceeded the 15-minute session budget. The 300-turn budget was not approached and finalize was reached.
